description: Our team consists of students who are passionate about science, technology, and space exploration. We enjoy researching, creating, and developing innovative ideas. By embracing an interdisciplinary approach, we aim to combine scientific thinking with technological solutions. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we hope to contribute to space exploration, address global challenges, and develop creative solutions for a better future.
summary:
Listen to the voice of the world.
Our project brings geography and music together to help people learn about
the world's continents in a fun and memorable way through music.
Rhythm Atlas is a digital project that aims to introduce the
world’s seven continents from both geographical and cultural
perspectives; users can explore the globe, select any
continent they wish, and listen to music associated with that
continent.
In this way, learning geography is no longer limited to just maps and
texts; it transforms into a more engaging and interactive experience,
enhanced by music!
